How to Make AI Imitate Your Voice

The Problem

AI can save you hours, but there’s a catch:

  • AI drafting your email and it doesn’t sound like you? You spend more time rewriting than writing.
  • Drafting a cover letter in 5 seconds with AI, but you spent 5 minutes rewriting it? That’s not a time-save.
  • Generic tone, wrong voice. Your personal brand gets lost in translation.

Why This Matters

Your voice is your personal brand. When AI doesn’t sound like you, every output feels inauthentic—and people notice.

The solution? Train your AI to understand how you think and communicate.

What You’ll Learn

In this free 30-minute webinar, I’ll show you:

  • How to capture your voice — Simple frameworks to teach AI your writing style, tone, and perspective
  • Prompt engineering for personality — Templates you can use immediately to get AI outputs that sound like you
  • Real-world examples — Emails, cover letters, LinkedIn posts, and professional communications
  • The one-time setup — 15 minutes of work to save hours every month

Who’s This For?

  • Professionals tired of rewriting AI drafts
  • Founders and CEOs who are busy but need their voice in every message
  • Anyone building their personal brand through writing
